defs.def: the act of listening to, looking at or thinking about sth/sb carefully 注意；专心；留心；注意力

ex.s: Be demanding on yourself and expect 100 percent attention to the task.
ex.t: 对自己严格要求，期待百分之百的注意力投入到任务中。

ex.s: I missed that paragraph because I was thinking of something else, but I’m going to keep on going and start paying close attention.”
ex.t: 我漏看了那一段，因为我在想别的事情，但我会继续读下去，并开始集中注意力。"

ex.s: Paying extra attention.
ex.t: 它通常是积极的。

ex.s: They can hold students' attention.
ex.t: 它们能吸引学生的注意力。

ex.s: If a pet cat is hungry, it will keep meowing to attract attention and find food.
ex.t: 如果宠物猫饿了，它会不停喵喵叫以引起注意并找到食物。

ex.s: Meowing starts as soon as a baby cat is brought to life and uses it to get the mother's attention and be fed.
ex.t: 喵喵叫从小猫一出生就开始，它用这种方式引起猫妈妈的注意并得到喂养。

ex.s: One of them got my attention.
ex.t: 他还为位于中国东南部的福州市设计了一台生态机器来净化运河水。

ex.s: To get the attention of her classmates.
ex.t: 如果火车行驶一英里需要53秒，那么你的时速是67.92英里。

ex.s: A noise at a window caught my attention, so I entered it.
ex.t: 窗户旁的响动引起了我的注意，于是我走了进去。

ex.s: The other children also jumped up all attention.
ex.t: John有好主意，肯定错不了。

ex.s: The other children also jumped up all attention.
ex.t: John有好主意，肯定错不了。

ex.s: Or maybe you end up switching your attention away from novels, and discover the history of romantic poets in England.
ex.t: 或者你可能最终把注意力从小说上转移开，发现了英国浪漫派诗人的历史。

ex.s: She paid no attention.
ex.t: 她没有注意。

ex.s: The group interaction and its effect drew the researchers' attention.
ex.t: 一支优秀的球队可能需要平衡——不仅要有A级球员，还要有一些乐于奉献的B级球员。

ex.s: He had my full attention and I had his.
ex.t: 他完全吸引了我的注意力，我也完全吸引了他的注意力。

ex.s: To train his attention      D.
ex.t: 舞蹈似乎完全改变了他们的感受。

ex.s: the outbreak of measles attracts the public attention
ex.t: 疫苗的过度使用。

ex.s: People’s attention wanders constantly.
ex.t: 人们的注意力经常走神。

ex.s: Adam and Galinsky tested the effect of simply wearing a white lab coat on people’s powers of attention.
ex.t: Adam和Galinsky测试了仅仅穿上白大褂对人注意力的影响。

ex.s: Learning to learn When you are extending or accepting an invitation, pay special attention to the following information:the date and time, what to bring, where to meet, etc.
ex.t: 学会学习：当你发出或接受邀请时，要特别注意以下信息：日期和时间、带什么、在哪里碰面等。

ex.s: Indeed, they made only half as many errors as those wearing their own clothes on the Stroop Test( one way of measuring attention).
ex.t: 事实上，他们在斯特鲁普测试（一种测量注意力的方法）中犯的错误只有穿自己衣服者的一半。

defs.def: interest that people show in sb/sth 兴趣；关注

ex.s: Whether or not we pay attention to the world’s “scentscape”, heat and pollution are causing it to shift.
ex.t: 无论我们是否关注世界的“气味景观”，高温和污染都在使它发生变化。

ex.s: It deserves greater attention.
ex.t: 它值得更多的关注。

ex.s: Drawing public attention to plastic waste.
ex.t: 引起公众对塑料垃圾的关注。

ex.s: The articles in magazines are generally short, which allows a child to finish reading a feature article without losing interest due to short attention span.
ex.t: 杂志上的文章一般都很短，这使得儿童可以完成一篇专题文章的阅读，而不会因为关注时间短而失去兴趣。

ex.s: So, we pay more attention to them.
ex.t: 所以我们会更加关注它们。

ex.s: This is when a pop star draws far more attention than, say, gradual biodiversity decline.
ex.t: 这就是当一位流行明星比，比如说，渐进的生物多样性衰退吸引更多关注时的情况。

ex.s: We pay little attention to food waste.
ex.t: 我们很少关注食物浪费。

ex.s: As quantum computing attracts more attention and funding, researchers may mislead investors, journalists, the public and, worst of all, themselves about their work’s potential.
ex.t: 随着量子计算吸引更多关注和资金，研究者可能误导投资者、记者、公众，最糟的是，误导他们自己关于工作潜力的认知。

ex.s: Mr Smith’s act    30    much of the public’s attention.
ex.t: 史密斯先生的行为____30____了公众的很多关注。

ex.s: The idea is that white coats are associated with scientists, who are in turn though to have close attention to detail.
ex.t: 身体动作改变人们的思维方式

ex.s: Although the continuing popular appeal of emotional intelligence is desirable, we hope that such attention will excite a greater interest in the scientific and scholarly study of emotion.
ex.t: 尽管情商持续的大众吸引力是可取的，我们希望这种关注能激发对情绪科学和学术研究的更大兴趣。

ex.s: I decided to play with him with only one toy for as long as it would keep his interest I expected that one toy would keep his attention for about five minutes, ten minutes, max I chose a red rubber ball—simple, universally available.
ex.t: 我决定只用一个玩具陪他玩，只要还能吸引他的兴趣就行；我估计一个玩具大概能让他专注五分钟，最多十分钟。我选了一个红色的橡皮球——简单、随处可见。

ex.s: Friendship needs care and attention to keep it in good health.
ex.t: 友谊需要关心和关注，才能保持良好的状态。

ex.s: The programme brought his actions to public attention, and Winton became a respected figure around the world.
ex.t: 这个节目使他的行为引起了公众的关注，温顿因此在全世界成为了一位受人尊敬的人物。

defs.def: things that sb does to try to please you or to show their interest in you 殷勤；关心

defs.def: special care, action or treatment 特别照料（或行动、处理）

ex.s: The smiles took everyone's attention from the surgery.
ex.t: "我特别喜欢父母和患者看到他的作品时的反应。

ex.s: I had been too nervous to pay attention when he introduced himself!
ex.t: 他们同意立即采取行动。

defs.def: the position soldiers take when they stand very straight with their feet together and their arms at their sides 立正姿势

ex.s: While the doctor concentrates on examining Lara’s ankle, I get her attention by doing a magic trick.
ex.t: 在英语课上，我们经常对一篇文本的整体和细节把握进行深入分析。
